bio.text: Jim Kingston is the Republican nominee for Georgia's 1st Congressional District, which includes Savannah, in the November 2026 general election.
He won the May 19, 2026 Republican primary with 52.7 percent of the vote in a six-candidate field.
He is the son of former U.S. Rep. Jack Kingston, who also represented the coastal Georgia district, and was 35 at the time of the primary.

sources.title: Victorious Jim Kingston awaits November opponent
Jim Kingston declares victory in GOP primary for Georgia's 1st Congressional District
